verdict.rationale: Omnara documents programmatic, non-dashboard operation: agents can be launched via the CLI, REST API, or TypeScript SDK. API keys work as bearer tokens with role-scoped access, a published OpenAPI spec is available, and event webhooks support event-driven automation, so the core of headless operation is covered. Missing for 10: explicit CI documentation or examples (e.g. a GitHub Actions recipe), evidence of non-interactive CLI flags and exit codes, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
